GET Market Info
NT8
Tradovate
Retrieve market session info NT8​

Returns real-time session status for an instrument, including whether the market is currently open or closed, the current or next session boundaries in UTC and exchange local time, and a countdown to the next state change. This is useful for algos that need to know whether the market is in session before placing orders, or UIs that display session timers.

Endpoint​

GET /v1/api/market/info

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Content-Type	application/json
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Query parameters​
NAME	TYPE	REQUIRED	DESCRIPTION
instrument	string	Required	Full native NT8 instrument name, including the contract month and year for futures (e.g., "ES 12-26").
Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



token = 'my-secret-token'

url = "https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/market/info"

headers = {

    "Authorization": f"Bearer {token}",

    "Content-Type": "application/json"

}



params = {"instrument": "ES 12-26"}



try:

    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, params=params)

    print(f"Response Code: {response.status_code}, Response Text: {response.text}")

except Exception as e:

    print(f"An error occurred: {e}")

Response​
200
400
401
403
408
429
500
{

  "success": true,

  "timestamp": "2026-03-18T20:46:29.0248281Z",

  "instrument": "ES 12-26",

  "timeZone": "Central Standard Time",

  "status": {

    "isOpen": true,

    "state": "Open"

  },

  "session": {

    "label": "Current Session",

    "utcStart": "2026-03-17T22:00:00.0000000Z",

    "utcEnd": "2026-03-18T21:00:00.0000000Z",

    "localStart": "2026-03-17 17:00:00",

    "localEnd": "2026-03-18 16:00:00",

    "countdown": "00:13:30",

    "action": "Until Close",

    "secondsRemaining": 810.9751719

  },

  "upcoming": {

    "utcStart": "2026-03-18T22:00:00.0000000Z",

    "utcEnd": "2026-03-19T21:00:00.0000000Z"

  }

}

Success field types​
FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	true on success.
timestamp, instrument, timeZone	string	Snapshot time, contract and time-zone name.
status	object	Session status.
status.isOpen	boolean	Whether the session is open.
status.state	string	Session state.
session, upcoming	object	Current/next session metadata.
session.label, session.action, session.countdown	string	Session label, countdown direction and display duration.
session.utcStart, session.utcEnd, session.localStart, session.localEnd	string	Session timestamps.
session.secondsRemaining	float	Countdown in seconds.
upcoming.utcStart, upcoming.utcEnd	string	Next session's UTC bounds.
Platform nuances​
INFO

When the market is closed, the session object reflects the next upcoming session with "label": "Next Session" and "action": "Until Open".

Your integration is responsible for selecting the correct instrument and contract month. Do not rely on continuous-symbol translation in direct NT8 API calls. See NT8 instrument names.

WebSocket API​

This request can also be made over the WebSocket API. Query parameters are passed inside args. Supply the full native instrument name in instrument.

{

  "action": "rpc",

  "id": "my-request-id",

  "api": "MarketInfo",

  "args": {

    "instrument": "ES 12-26"

  }

}
